name: macos-restart
title: Restart with warning
description: Schedules a restart (shutdown -r +minutes, 2 to 60, default 10). macOS shows no warning on screen to a signed-in user, so tell them first; open apps are closed when the time comes. Can be cancelled with "Cancel the restart".
measure: if [ "$min" -lt 2 ] || [ "$min" -gt 60 ]; then arh_blocker "The delay must be 2 to 60 minutes"; fi
if [ -n "$user" ] && [ "$user" != root ]; then arh_info "Signed in" "$user"; arh_warning_user=1; else arh_info "Signed in" "nobody"; fi
if [ -n "${arh_warning_user:-}" ]; then arh_warn "$user is signed in and macOS shows them no warning: unsaved work is lost when the restart comes"; fi
apply: shutdown -r "+$ARH_PARAM_MINUTES" "ARH IT: this Mac will restart in $ARH_PARAM_MINUTES minutes." </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ $code -eq 0 ]; then arh_note "Restart scheduled in $ARH_PARAM_MINUTES minutes"; else arh_note "shutdown exit $code"; fi
